title: Quality
line: Start cleanup with a measured scan of the repository.

beats.caption: You ask for a cleanup pass with `/quality`.
The agent starts checking what the findings mean.

takeaway.title: Start from a finding
takeaway.line: Check what uses the code before you decide on a cleanup.

notes: Scroll to the measured report before returning to the agent's reply. The unused-file findings still need a caller check.

title.text: A cleanup pass is easier to review when you can see the measurements it started from.

scene.text: Slash quality runs the installed CRAP and Deadwood analyzers on this project. It hands the report to the agent, which starts checking whether a suspected unused export has callers.

takeaway.text: Investigate the finding before editing. A passing check after the change gives you evidence that the behavior still works.
